reason: Conversation 2 identified both likely causes (dial on max plus food blocking the rear vent) immediately, told the homeowner exactly what to set the dial to (middle), advised clearing the vents, gave a sensible 24-hour settle period, and correctly reserved the thermostat/air-flap engineer escalation for if freezing persists away from the back. Conversation 1 asked the homeowner the same question three times, never answered her repeated direct question about what to set the dial to, and told her to 'leave it to settle at the new setting' twice despite her saying she had not changed anything. Neither raised safety or part issues inappropriately, but Conversation 1's looping, unresponsive behaviour left the homeowner without the one piece of guidance she asked for.
